evals.prompt: I want ZZ to ship a small bar widget that shows the free space on / (like '42G free'), refreshing every minute, with a setting for the mount point. Make it an optional wizard choice that's on by default, and wire everything up properly in the repo (catalog, managed config, tests, docs). Don't run a real install.
evals.expected_output: A plugin directory under dotfiles/dms/.config/DankMaterialShell/plugins/ with a valid plugin.json (widget type, settings_write permission), Widget.qml with both bar pills using Theme.*, Settings.qml with matching pluginId, a product-link row in config/managed-config.tsv, a catalog unit under catalog/units/desktop/ with [choice] and an [[install]] payload, a Bats test, docs bullet, and passing catalog validation plus print-plan dry run.
assertions: Plugin directory exists under dotfiles/dms/.config/DankMaterialShell/plugins/ with plugin.json, a widget QML, and a settings QML
plugin.json passes validate_plugin.py with no errors (widget type, settings_write permission, camelCase id)
Widget QML defines both horizontalBarPill and verticalBarPill and uses Theme.* rather than hardcoded colors
config/managed-config.tsv gains a product-link row linking the plugin directory to ~/.config/DankMaterialShell/plugins/<Name> with required command dms
A catalog unit under catalog/units/desktop/ declares [choice] with default = true, config naming the new component, and an [[install]] step with a payload
lib/catalog.py validate passes and ./install.sh print-plan --select desktop=<id> --dry-run lists the plugin link
A Bats test covers manifest validity and the planned link, and the relevant suites pass
No non-dry install was run and no files under ~/.config were modified

evals.prompt: add a launcher plugin to zz so typing ';' in the DMS launcher searches my zoxide directories and opens the chosen one in ghostty. depends on zoxide obviously
evals.expected_output: A launcher-type plugin with trigger ';', getItems/executeItem implemented via Proc.runCommand or Process against zoxide, a StartupCheck for zoxide, dependencies listed in the manifest and zoxide in the unit's packages, product-link row, catalog unit, validation and tests.
assertions: A launcher-type plugin directory exists under dotfiles/dms/.config/DankMaterialShell/plugins/ with plugin.json declaring trigger ';'
The launcher QML is a plain Item with getItems and executeItem, and runs zoxide through Proc.runCommand or a Quickshell Process
A StartupCheck.qml gates activation on zoxide being installed and the manifest lists zoxide in dependencies
The catalog unit's [[install]] step lists zoxide in packages
config/managed-config.tsv gains a product-link row for the plugin directory
validate_plugin.py and lib/catalog.py validate pass; print-plan dry run lists the link
Tests were added and pass; no non-dry install ran and nothing under ~/.config changed

evals.prompt: What would it take for ZZ to ship a DMS daemon plugin that runs zz-sync-icon-theme whenever the wallpaper changes, enabled out of the box on fresh installs? Just plan it and explain the tradeoffs, don't write code yet.
evals.expected_output: An explanation that identifies daemon type, the product-link directory row, a base vs optional decision, the plugin_settings.json enable-by-default seeding requirement in lib/dms.sh plus its one-shot limitation on existing installs, and the live-test path via dms ipc plugin-scan; no files written.
